purpose: Classify external video-derived material so the canonical agent can use useful ideas without promoting indirect AI summaries into unverified technical truth.
global_rules: AI-transcribed or AI-analyzed video content is a curation input, not final proof.
A direct timestamped source can justify a case record, but SGDK/Mega Drive integration still requires local constraints and validation.
An aggregate count or conclusion from another agent is backlog evidence until individual sources are available.
No external technique can override AGENTS.md, SGDK 2.11 headers, project manifests or emulator evidence gates.
When source confidence is lower than the requested claim, downgrade the claim or request stronger evidence.

confidence_levels.meaning: The source is mentioned but no transcript, timestamp, file, link or local artifact is available.
The material is an AI summary/transcription with no independent local verification.
The transcript or analysis includes source links/timestamps and concrete claims, but has not been independently checked against the video/tool/docs.
The concept is cross-checked against primary documentation, local tool behavior, source code, SGDK headers or verified exported data.
The technique has local build/runtime/emulator evidence in the workspace.
forbidden_use: final AAA release without full evidence ladder

confidence_levels.meaning: The technique has source reliability, local validation, owner skill, machine-readable contract and required emulator/VDP evidence when runtime claims are involved.
allowed_use: candidate_aaa support when all activated gates pass

primary source review or transcript verification
emulator evidence when runtime is claimed

case_application.blocked_use: Claim validated technical truth or runtime evidence without local validation.
